ns2:course.label: Cities and Immigrants
ns2:course.description: Focuses on the experiences of United States cities and towns undergoing rapid demographic economic, social, and cultural changes and the local responses to those changes, including local policy making, land-use regulations, community controversy, and grassroots activism. Prerequisite: UP 260 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: UP 260 or consent of instructor.
